req.title: Login rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall render an 'Incorrect password.' error when the password hash comparison fails.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /auth/login must render an 'Incorrect password.' error when the password hash comparison fails. We need: (1) a positive case confirming correct credentials succeed without the error, (2) a negative case confirming wrong password produces exactly 'Incorrect password.' in the response body with HTTP 200, (3) a boundary case distinguishing 'Incorrect password.' from 'Incorrect username.' to ensure the right branch fires. Additional tests cover the decision table (wrong user vs wrong password) and state transition (session not set on failure). All assertions use exact values to kill constant/operator mutations.

tests.name: test_login_correct_credentials_no_error_message
preconditions: Database contains user Rahul with password 'stone' (id=1)
Application is running in TESTING mode
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'Incorrect password.'
Response body does NOT contain 'Incorrect username.'
trace: R-FLASKR-010: correct password must NOT trigger the error path
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_correct_credentials_no_error_message():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert b'Incorrect password.' not in r.data
    assert b'Incorrect username.' not in r.data
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

test_login_correct_credentials_no_error_message()

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_wrong_password_session_not_set():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Ishaan', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect password.' in r.data
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess

test_login_wrong_password_session_not_set()
